{{Quote|Chiss sages conclude that the Yuuzhan Vong must have spent generations traveling between galaxies. These invaders are not likely to consider the so-called Unknown Regions a daunting prospect.|Colonel Jagged Fel, to Baron Soontir Fel|<ref name="DJ">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>}}
The '''Chiss sages''' were a title and group within the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].

==History==
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] sages believed that the extragalactic invaders had traveled for countless centuries across the void to reach [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
